Following documents are required to be submitted along-with the form:
  * [Proof of PAN](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#proof-of-pan) (the one currently in use - mentioned at the top of the application) if available;
  * [Proof of Identity;](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#proof-id)
  * [Proof of Address;](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#proof-id)
  * [Proof of Date of Birth (for Individual and Karta of HUF)](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#proof-id)
  * [Proof in support of changes sought*, if any;](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#proof-in-support)
  * [Proof of PAN(s) surrendered, if any;](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#proof-in-surrend)

[ What documents can be submitted as proof of PAN? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#english-collapseSeven)
Any one of the following documents can be submitted as proof of PAN:
  1. Copy of PAN card
  2. Copy of PAN allotment letter

No other documents are acceptable as proof of PAN. If any proof of PAN is not available, the application will be accepted on a 'good effort' basis. [ What documents can be submitted as proof of PAN surrendered? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#english-collapseEight)
Any one of the following documents can be submitted as proof of PAN surrendered:
  1. Copy of PAN card
  2. Copy of PAN allotment letter

No other documents are acceptable as valid proof of PAN surrendered. If any proof of PAN surrendered is not available, then application will not be accepted.
